recommendations.title: Relaunch Ads with Top-Performing 'LEGIT SURE' Creative
recommendations.detail: Since all campaigns are paused, immediately relaunch by deploying the historically top-performing creative 'LEGIT SURE 100% 2024-05-15...'. This creative has demonstrated highly efficient historical performance with 318 messages at a $29.18 cost-per-message and a robust 5.12% CTR.

recommendations.title: Deploy Low Downpayment (DP) Xpander Offer
recommendations.detail: Reactivate the highly engaging '🚙 03 - Xpander GLX AT | Low DP' ad angle targeting '📍 Metro South | 25–55'. It generated a superb 8.22% CTR and a low cost-per-message of $32.54 during its active run, proving to be a high-intent offer for car buyers.

recommendations.title: Address High CPC & CPM Trends upon Reactivation
recommendations.detail: When relaunching, monitor CPMs closely. The last 7 active days showed a very high CPM of $441.33 and CPC of $11.84. To combat this, leverage Broad targeting or expand the geographic targeting beyond Metro South to lower inventory bidding costs.
